SHAR Production

Production Evidence Records

25 machine-readable contracts with bilingual guidance, JSON Schema, synthetic fixtures and browser validation.

brief-approval

Brief approval

Records who approved a production brief and which revision was accepted.

talent-consent

Talent consent

Records consent scope, territory and expiry without storing media.

location-permit

Location permit

Records the permitted location, dates and issuing authority.

music-license

Music license

Records track usage rights, channels, territory and term.

insurance-certificate

Insurance certificate

Records coverage reference and validity for a production.

call-sheet-acknowledgment

Call sheet acknowledgment

Records receipt of a dated call sheet revision.

safety-briefing

Safety briefing

Records briefing topic, responsible lead and attendance state.

camera-report

Camera report

Records camera roll, clip range and acquisition format.

sound-report

Sound report

Records sound roll, sample rate and channel notes.

dit-checksum

DIT checksum

Records a verified SHA-256 transfer digest and source set.

color-pipeline

Color pipeline

Records input color space, working space and viewing transform.

vfx-turnover

VFX turnover

Records turnover package, frame range and handles.

edit-approval

Edit approval

Records the approved edit revision and decision state.

caption-qc

Caption QC

Records caption format, language and validation result.

loudness-qc

Loudness QC

Records measured programme loudness and true peak.

accessibility-review

Accessibility review

Records reviewed accessibility features and unresolved issues.

localization-signoff

Localization signoff

Records locale, reviewer and approved localization revision.

delivery-manifest

Delivery manifest

Records manifest identifier, asset count and package checksum.

archive-inventory

Archive inventory

Records archive roles, storage copies and integrity review.

ai-provenance

AI provenance

Records declared AI-assisted operation, model family and human review.

cgi-asset-provenance

CGI asset provenance

Records CGI source, authoring tool and licensing reference.

sustainability-log

Sustainability log

Records measured production activity and declared unit.

supplier-bid-evaluation

Supplier bid evaluation

Records criteria, bid reference and review decision.

incident-report

Incident report

Records incident time, severity and follow-up state without medical detail.

final-release-gate

Final release gate

Records required gate results and final release decision.
